description: This source file defines the PhotoLibraryService class which provides an interface to fetch and process photos from the device photo library. It handles authorization, image fetching, resizing, and encoding images into JPEG format within specified size constraints. It ensures that the payloads do not exceed WebSocket limitations when transmitting photos.

classes.name: PhotoLibraryService
classes.description: A service class that fetches the latest photos from the device photo library, processes them into base64-encoded JPEG images, and enforces payload size constraints for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Fetches the latest photos from the photo library with specified parameters, encodes them in base64, and respects maximum payload size constraints.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks the current authorization status for photo library access to determine if the app has permission.

methods.name: renderAsset
methods.description: Resizes, processes, and encodes a PHAsset into a JPEG image within size constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Compresses and resizes a UIImage to ensure its base64-encoded size does not exceed the specified maximum.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes a UIImage to a specified target width, maintaining aspect ratio.
